senses.gloss: (= הָא כָא; cmp. preced.) here, hither; in this case, now.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 22:5">Targ. Gen. XXII, 5</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ</cite> top <he>היך אתית להכה</he> how didst thou come hither?—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:6:5">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ומעייל להכא וכ׳</he> and I shall bring hither &c.—
<cite ref="Sukkah 4a:11">Succ. 4ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>התם … ה׳</he> there (in the case first mentioned) …, here (in this case).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 4a">R. Hash. 4ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מה׳</he> from the following (Biblical passage &c.).

<cite ref="Pesachim 114a:7">Pes. 114ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ה׳ נמי וכ׳</he> (abbr. <he>ה״נ</he>) in this case, too, &c.; a. v. fr.—In Babli: <he>ה׳</he> here, in Babylonia, <cite ref="E00953"><he>התם</he></cite>, <cite ref="V00693"><he>תמן</he></cite> in Palestine; in Y. the reverse.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 5a">Snh. 5ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ bot. <he>דבנן דה׳</he> Palestine scholars.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:1:4">Y. Keth. II, 26ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="E00459"><he>הֵינוּמָא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:7">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>מן ה׳</he> from now, v. <cite ref="E00532"><he>הָלָא</he></cite>; a. v. fr.
